observation.command:
nohup bash -c '
for img in quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.4.0 getmeili/meilisearch:v1.26.0 postgres:16-alpine gresau/localstack-persist:4 axllent/mailpit:v1.29.3 darthsim/imgproxy:latest python:3.12-alpine nginx:alpine; do
  echo ">>> pulling $img"
  docker pull "$img" 2>&1 | tail -2
done
echo "ALL_PULLS_DONE"
' > /tmp/docker-pulls2.log 2>&1 &
echo "pulls2 pid $!"
